summary: Startup Wise Guys currently lists The Founders Club as an open 20th cohort program with a July 12, 2026 application deadline and online 3-month B2B startup format.

proposed_event.name: Startup Wise Guys The Founders Club Cohort 20
proposed_event.description: 3-month online B2B startup program for founders and early teams, with mentorship, cofounder matching, and possible SWG investment.

dates.date_range_text: Applications for the 20th Founders Club cohort close July 12, 2026; official agenda lists online sessions from July 22 through November 4, but the agenda year is not stated.

sources.title: All programs - Startup Wise Guys
sources.supports: Lists The Founders Club and states the application deadline is July 12th, 2026.

sources.title: The Founders Club - Startup Wise Guys
sources.supports: Official program page supports the 20th cohort being open, 3-month online B2B startup format, rolling review, online delivery, CET session time, program cost, possible investment up to €100K, follow-on up to €250K, AWS credits/partner perks, target sectors, and agenda dates without stated year.

notes: Program start/end dates were left null because the agenda lists month/day dates but does not explicitly state the year on the program page.
The deadline year comes from the official all-programs listing, which states July 12th, 2026.
Founders Club is broader than a classic accelerator, but the official page describes it as designed to accelerate B2B startups and it includes mentorship, pitch work, and possible investment.
